# Getting started

In this section, we will create a basic OpenLayers project.

## 1. Install the required software

You will need:

- Node.js
- Git
- a code editor such as Visual Studio Code

For the OpenLayers-specific setup, see the
[OpenLayers Quick Start guide](https://openlayers.org/doc/quickstart.html).

## 2. Create the project

Open a terminal and create a new OpenLayers application:

```{bash}
npm create ol-app my-app
cd my-app
npm start
